name: @pearl-sol/cadre-api
description: Cadre public backend API (/v1): live stats from the explorer indexer, inference (models, prices, gateway pass-through), agent profiles, wallet helpers (balances, unsigned txs, broadcast of signed txs). Read-only on keys: it never holds a user key. No runtime dependencies (@solana/web3.js is a dev dependency, used only by the parity tests).
